key.name: selected-device
key.summary: Device to scan from
key.description: SANE device to acquire images from.

key.name: document-type
key.summary: Type of document being scanned
key.description: Type of document being scanned. This setting decides on the scan resolution, colors and post-processing.

key.name: paper-width
key.summary: Width of paper in tenths of a mm
key.description: The width of the paper in tenths of a mm (or 0 for automatic paper detection).

key.name: paper-height
key.summary: Height of paper in tenths of a mm
key.description: The height of the paper in tenths of a mm (or 0 for automatic paper detection).

key.name: brightness
key.summary: Brightness of scan
key.description: The brightness adjustment from -100 to 100 (0 being none).

key.name: contrast
key.summary: Contrast of scan
key.description: The contrast adjustment from -100 to 100 (0 being none).

key.name: text-dpi
key.summary: Resolution for text scans
key.description: The resolution in dots-per-inch to use when scanning text.

key.name: photo-dpi
key.summary: Resolution for image scans
key.description: The resolution in dots-per-inch to use when scanning images.

key.name: page-side
key.summary: Page side to scan
key.description: The page side to scan.

key.name: save-directory
key.summary: Directory to save files to
key.description: The directory to save files to. Defaults to the documents directory if unset.

key.name: save-format
key.summary: File format that is used for saving image files
key.description: MIME type that is used for saving image files. Examples of supported MIME types: image/jpeg, image/png, application/pdf

key.name: jpeg-quality
key.summary: Quality value to use for JPEG compression
key.description: Quality value to use for JPEG compression.

key.name: clean-background
key.summary: Whiten the paper background when saving
key.description: When enabled, near-white areas of colour and greyscale scans are made pure white and midtones slightly darkened as the document is saved. This removes paper grain and tint, making saved files noticeably smaller while keeping print and pencil legible. Turn it off for photos or tinted paper, whose lightest shades would be washed out. The scan shown in the app is not changed.

key.name: page-delay
key.summary: Delay in millisecond between pages
key.description: Delay in millisecond between pages.

key.name: postproc-enabled
key.summary: Whether or not postprocessing is enabled
key.description: Whether or not postprocessing is enabled.

key.name: postproc-script
key.summary: The path to the postprocessing script
key.description: The path to the postprocessing script.

key.name: postproc-arguments
key.summary: Additional arguments for the postprocessing script
key.description: Additional arguments for the postprocessing script.

key.name: postproc-keep-original
key.summary: Whether or not to keep the original, unprocessed file
key.description: Whether or not to keep the original, unprocessed file. The "_orig" filename will be added to the filename immediately before the file extension.

key.name: auto-crop
key.summary: Automatically crop scanned pages to the detected document
key.description: When enabled, each new scan is analysed and a Custom Crop rectangle is placed around the detected document (the brighter region against the scanner bed). The crop is fully adjustable afterwards. This needs a background darker than the paper, such as the black backing of many sheet-fed scanners; against a white lid nothing is detected and the page is left uncropped.

key.name: auto-straighten
key.summary: Automatically straighten skewed scanned pages
key.description: When enabled, each new scan is analysed for mild skew (up to about ten degrees) and rotated so the document edges align with the page axes before any auto-crop is applied.

key.name: autoname-enabled
key.summary: Suggest a filename when saving by analysing the first page
key.description: When enabled, the first page of the document is sent to a configured OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint and the response is used to pre-fill the Save dialog with a date (if found) and a short descriptive filename.

key.name: autoname-endpoint
key.summary: OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint for auto-naming
key.description: Full URL of an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint. The default targets a local Ollama install.

key.name: autoname-api-key
key.summary: API key for the auto-naming endpoint
key.description: Bearer token sent in the Authorization header. Leave blank for local endpoints that do not require auth.

key.name: autoname-model
key.summary: Model identifier sent to the auto-naming endpoint
key.description: Vision-capable model name. Examples: qwen3.5:4b (Ollama), gpt-4o-mini (OpenAI), llava (Ollama).
